objectives.description: Capture golden baseline before any edit
Single upstream jq pass replaces per-task status re-parse for terminal/active counts
Single jq call over active_projects producing all fields, sorted descending
Pure-bash formatting side, zero jq spawns per task
Fold sort -rn into jq pass via sort_by(-.project_number)
Diff regenerated output against golden baseline until empty

approaches_tried.approach: Per-field @base64 encoding (one base64 spawn per field, ~8 per task)
approaches_tried.reason: Only reduced wall time to ~4.8-5.0s (from 6.4s baseline) -- traded ~8-12 jq spawns per task for ~8 base64 spawns per task, same order of magnitude of subprocess-spawn cost. Superseded by whole-row base64 encoding (one spawn per task).

bash's read collapses consecutive tab delimiters (tab is in bash's IFS-whitespace class), silently dropping empty middle fields (e.g. unset effort) and shifting every subsequent field left by one position. Superseded by IFS=$'\x1f' (Unit Separator, not in the IFS-whitespace class).

approaches_tried.approach: IFS=$'\x1f' read for splitting the whole-row base64-decoded blob
approaches_tried.reason: plain `read` is line-oriented regardless of IFS and stops at the first real embedded newline, truncating multi-line description fields and blanking every field after them. Superseded by `mapfile -d $'\x1f'`, which uses Unit Separator as the record terminator instead of newline.

deviations.description: NDJSON with base64-encoded fields (per-field @base64) as literally suggested by the plan
deviations.reason: Per-field base64 only reduced subprocess spawn count from ~8-12 jq/task to ~8 base64/task -- same order of magnitude, wall time barely improved. Whole-row base64 (one spawn per task) is what actually removes the spawn-count cost; see the plan's Phase 4 'Measured results' and 'Deviation' notes for full detail.
deviations.annotation: *(completed: each row is all 10 fields joined by the ASCII Unit Separator then base64-encoded ONCE per row -- see deviation note below on why per-field base64 was abandoned)*

notes: Golden baseline: 6.412s, 3674 lines. Post-rewrite output byte-identical (empty diff) in both --dry-run and real atomic-write mode. Paired interleaved A/B under identical concurrent system load: pre-rewrite ~9.6s avg, post-rewrite ~4.1s avg (~2.3x total, ~4.4x on the in-file_scope per-task-loop portion after subtracting the out-of-scope generate-task-order.sh ~2.5s component). jq spawn count reduced from ~8-12/task to exactly 2 for the whole run. bash -n clean; test-state-write-concurrency.sh and test-state-write-regen-timing.sh both still pass in full; no task-number citations introduced.
